name: Being A Good Steward
overview: Scripture reveals that all things belong to the Lord, as David declares that the earth and all who dwell in it are God's possession (Psalms 24:1). Believers are entrusted as stewards of God's resources, called to manage them faithfully and wisely, as illustrated in the parable of the servants given their master's goods (Matthew 25:14) and the faithful steward appointed to care for his household (Luke 12:42). Faithfulness in small responsibilities reflects a person's trustworthiness in greater matters (Luke 16:10), and generosity is encouraged when it is within one's power to help others (Proverbs 3:27). Jesus observed the giving of offerings, highlighting the importance of sincere stewardship with what God has entrusted to each individual (Mark 12:41).
